bios.label: Long
bios.text:
Nivedkrishna Thavarayil is a creative strategist and director based in New York and New Jersey. He builds campaigns people stop scrolling for, organic and paid, then directs the series that keep them watching.

He has directed more than twelve short-form series for Canvas, including Face Value, a micro-documentary about a makeup artist's road to New York Fashion Week, along with Red Flags, Dear NYC, Taser Fight Championship and Demo Day, shot across New York, Boston, Baltimore, San Francisco and Los Angeles. Through Thava Studio he has grown more than twenty brands, from restaurants to creators. His relaunch for director Abi Varghese's Infamous Coconuts drew 19.2 million views across 76 reels with no paid spend.

Before New York, he worked in creative strategy at the meme marketing agency WLDD in Bangalore, where his work included The Pope's Exorcist cinema stunt for Sony Pictures India and Thank You Durex. He trained in directing at the New York Film Academy's one-year filmmaking conservatory, where he made the Dean's List. He plans shoots in Directure AI and produces with a Claude Code pipeline connected to Premiere Pro, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, and every output still goes through a human edit.
